historical_record.description: The buildings on three lots fronting Buena Vista Avenue West, Haight Street and Central Avenue were in use as a board-and-care facility for 36 hospital out-patients. The City Planning Commission unanimously approved, for two years and with six conditions, a board-and-care facility for 48 patients in the existing buildings.
